text.p: Boston marathon champion Lameck Aguta was still unconscious on Wednesday, four days after he was admitted to hospital following a car accident, his twin brother Zachary Nyambaso said on Wednesday.
Doctors said his condition was still stable and they would issue a bulletin if there were any changes.
Kenyan Aguta, also the Commonwealth 10,000 metres champion, sustained head injuries in the crash but a brain scan showed no serious damage.
Doctors, who had said on Monday they were encouraged by his condition, were concerned on Wednesday that the athlete was still unconscious and that his condition remained largely unchanged.
Police said Aguta was injured when his car went out of control and landed in a ditch in his native Rift Valley province. The driver of the car and another man were slightly injured.
